local function capitalize(word) return word:sub(1, 1):upper() .. word:sub(2) end

local identifiers = {
    "user_name", "maxRetryCount", "ShoppingCartItem", "background-color", "get_last_login_time",
    "isEmailAddressValid",
}
for _, identifier in ipairs(identifiers) do
    local separated = identifier:gsub("([A-Z])", " %1"):gsub("[_-]", " "):lower()
    local words, capitals = {}, {}
    for word in separated:gmatch("%S+") do
        words[#words + 1] = word
        capitals[#capitals + 1] = capitalize(word)
    end
    local camel = words[1] .. table.concat(capitals, "", 2)
    io.write(string.format("%s: snake=%s, camel=%s, pascal=%s, kebab=%s\n",
        identifier, table.concat(words, "_"), camel, table.concat(capitals), table.concat(words, "-")))
end
